final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top_combo.combo_count / total.total_bonds, 2) as percentage FROM (SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(c.bond_id) as combo_count FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element <= a2.element GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element ORDER BY combo_count DESC LIMIT 1) top_combo CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_bonds FROM bond) total
